units: STL has no unit tag; values are in the file units (almost certainly millimetres: maze ~6030 x 3062 mm)
axes: Right-handed, Z up. X = long side of maze, Y = short side, Z = vertical. Original orientation preserved, no rotation applied.
frame: Maze-centered frame: origin at XY centre of maze outer bounds, floor at z=0 (applies to maze_clean.stl and all positions below). Original file frame was already centred, so shift is ~0.

cylinder.mesh_origin: centre of base (x,y at axis, z at bottom)
cylinder.note: Thin-walled tube, rotationally symmetric about Z; yaw irrelevant.

cross_structure.mesh_origin: XY centre of its bounding box, bottom at z=0
cross_structure.note: Flat plate lying in the YZ plane (thickness ~45 along X): cross-shaped body with circular head on top. Includes a thin (0.1) ground sheet beneath it.
